A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]] was fought during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It was the first engagement between the New Republic and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="TEA" /> After the decisive [[Battle of Colla]], the New Republic send a task force to liberate [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]] in order to secure a front on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] abandoned the [[Obroa-skai system/Legends|Obroa-skai system]] due to the progress of the new Republic forces. However, they were defeated by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] Zsinj. Corsin was eventually [[Battle of Corsin (Hunt for Zsinj)|freed]] [[7 ABY/Legends|two years later]].<ref name="TEA" />
